simple.meaning: properly, to level , i.e. equalize ; figuratively, to resemble ; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁוָה (H7737) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 21 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׁוָה (shâvâh) means properly, to level , i.e. equalize ; figuratively, to resemble ; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 22 34.

definitions.full: H7737. shavah I. שָׁוָה verb ( be even, smooth , see Pi`el , hence) agree with, be like, resemble (Arabic II. make even, flat, uniform (with something else); Aramaic שְׁוָא (derived species) be like , be equal, fit, like , Pa`el lay out smoothly , Aph`el make plain, fit, worthy ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular שׁ ׳לֹא לִי Job 33:27 (si vera lectio) it was not equalled to me , i.e. (see infra; according to most) not requited (so De Di Da, and Isa 16:6 ᵑ7 ); Bu שִׁוָּה לֹא אֵל God did not requite (or שִׁלֵּם for שׁוה ); Du כַעֲוֺנִי שִׁוָּה לֹא (compare ᵐ5 ); Imperfect 1singular of אֶשְׁוֶה ֗֗֗ אֶלמִֿי ׳י, 40:25 to whom shall I be like ? (|| תְּדַמְּיוּנִי ), implying that he is incompare; 3 masculine plural יִשְׁווּבָֿהּ לֹא Prov 3:15 are not comparable with her (wisdom), so 8:11 ; 2 masculine singular מֶּןתִּֿשְׁוֶהלֿוֺ 26:4 lest thou be like him (a fool); Participle בְּ שֹׁוֶה Est 7:4 is not an equivalent for ; with לִ , suitable for 3:8 , so 1:22 Hi Or Ry Kau (reading עִמּוֺ שֹׁוֶה כֹּל for עַמּוֺ כִּלְשׁוֺן , but see Siegf.); adequate for 5:13 . Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular שִׁוָּה Isa 28:25 he hath levelled its (the ground's) surface; 1 singular נַפְשִׁי וְדוֺמַמְתִּי שִׁוִּיתִי Psa 131:2 I have smoothed (composed) and stilled my soul ; so, that is נַפְשִׁי Isa 38:13 ᵑ9 Ges De and others; Houb Lo Che Du and others read שִׁוַּעְתִּי I cried ; accusative מִשְׁמָּטִים Psa 119:30 accounted suitable , meet (|| בָּחָ֑רְתִּי אֱמוּנָח דֶּרֶךְ ), Hi, compare Gr 119:128 (see Qal Est 3:8 ); We inserts לְנֶגְדִּי (II. ׳שׁ , compare Psa 16:8 ); Zenner Du אִזִּיתִי . Hiph`il make like: Imperfect 1singular אַשְׁוֶחלָֿךְ מָח Lam 2:13 (|| אֲדַמֶּה ); 2 masculine plural וְתַשְׁווּ תְדַמְּיוּנִי לְמִי Isa 46:5 (compare Qal Isa 40:25 ). Nithp. (apparently) Perfect 3feminine singular נִשְׁתָּ֑וָה (for נִשְׁתְּוָה ) Prov 27:15 are alike , but read probably Niph`al 3 feminine singular נִשְׁוָ֑תָה Ges § 75x Toy and others — תשׁוה Job 30:22 Kt see II. שׁוא . II.
